model_name: SkullGreymon NO AMS Multi-Color Parted Statue
description: Anime Statue Series — SkullGreymon Ultra-Real Multi-Color Parted Statue 1. Design Concept Following our previous statue designs, we are raising the stakes by reinterpreting an absolute embodiment of childhood nostalgia and dread from Digimon — SkullGreymon . This sculpture reimagines the iconic beast as a hyper-real, high-impact bio-statue, focusing on terrifying presence, complex skeletal silhouette, and raw mass, while preserving the unhinged chaotic nature of his design. Rather than standard mechanical geometry, the design channels an exaggerated organic skeletal tension. The prominent exposed spine, massive crushing claws, the crimson heart pulsating within the ribcage, and the organic torpedo (Ground Zero missile) mounted on its spine are all brought into vivid physicality. Every contour of the decayed bone structure is sculpted to evoke a sense of absolute feral power compressed within a motionless, striking pose. The core breakthrough of this work lies in its "No-AMS" Multi-Color Parted Engineering . Every major visual element—the monolithic bone chassis, the red heart, the golden back missile, and even the piercing green eyes—exists as a completely separated individual printed part . This means you can achieve a professional, multi-colored showcase finish straight off the printer simply by swapping filaments between prints—no expensive AMS system or multi-material swapping required. 2. Engineering & Assembly Guide Despite its highly aggressive and intricate skeletal form, the model is fully optimized for large-scale FDM printing stability and a rewarding manual assembly experience: Glue-Free Snap-Fit Fit: Under ideal conditions, the components are engineered to join together via physical friction joints, requiring no glue . However, due to dimensional variances across different printers and material shrinkage, tolerances may vary (tighter or looser). If a joint is too tight, use a heat gun or hair dryer to warm the internal connection point for a few seconds. This softens the plastic just enough for a flush fit without altering the external aesthetics. Align Before Insertion: PLA is a dense, non-flexible material. To prevent breakage of fine bone pegs, always align the part to your desired final angle before pushing it in . Attempting to forcefully rotate the joint after assembly may snap the internal connections. Securing the Core: The internal heart and eye pieces are the smallest independent color components. While a firm press usually locks them into the skull and ribcage securely, feel free to add a drop of CA glue (super glue) for absolute permanent stability depending on your print's tolerances. 3. Display, Scale, & Customization This piece thrives in apocalyptic wasteland, ruined factory, or toxic-mutation display scenes. Its wide, forward-leaning, and hyper-aggressive silhouette lends dramatic readability for unparalleled shelf presence. Ultimate Scale Contrast: To accommodate diverse collection spaces, this model is engineered to scale beautifully. In the provided product photography, we have showcased a side-by-side comparison photo of the absolute maximum (Max) and minimum (Min) printable sizes available in the print profiles. Whether you choose to print the colossal centerpiece (Max size) to capture every microscopic bone grain and shadow transition, or the compact miniature version (Min size) that flawlessly retains the multi-color part separation layout, the visual impact remains uncompromisingly premium. 4. Conclusion The Hyper-Real SkullGreymon statue stands as a definitive core collectible for anime fans and print collectors who adore stylized plausibility and catastrophic charm. It proves that high collectible impact is not born from moving joints, but from unfiltered sculptural presence. It transforms a childhood memory into tangible awe, blending menace, skeletal weight, and surreal realism into one essential masterpiece that completely dominates the skies—or ruins—it guards. Quick Tips: Avoid enabling photography/timelapse mode for this highly complex, multi-angled skeletal print to minimize print failure risks caused by printhead travel. Properly calibrate your machine's flow rate and ensure your filament is completely dry. Bambu gray and white remain my personal go-to choices for foundational bone structures. Needle-nose pliers combined with Bambu’s FAC002-N scraper will make cleaning up the support structures around the intricate ribcage and claws incredibly efficient.

Abecedario completo de letras con efecto globo, diseñado para crear nombres, palabras, carteles decorativos o proyectos personalizados con una estética inspirada en los clásicos globos metalizados. Las letras pueden imprimirse de varias formas, aunque recomiendo imprimirlas en posición vertical. De esta manera se conserva mejor el efecto volumétrico del diseño y se obtiene una superficie más limpia. Para garantizar una buena adhesión a la base, especialmente si se imprimen varias letras a la vez, es recomendable utilizar un brim amplio. Las letras mostradas en las fotografías se han impreso con filamento tricolor. Si utilizas este tipo de material, conviene prestar atención a la orientación de cada pieza, ya que el ángulo de impresión influirá directamente en la distribución de los colores y en el resultado final. Para obtener el mejor acabado posible, recomiendo utilizar una altura de capa reducida o, preferiblemente, altura de capa variable. El efecto globo se basa en superficies curvas y transiciones suaves que pierden definición cuando se utilizan capas demasiado gruesas. También es posible imprimir las letras en horizontal, pero en ese caso es especialmente importante utilizar una altura de capa muy fina o altura de capa variable para mantener el aspecto redondeado y evitar que se pierda parte del efecto característico del diseño. Se incluyen todas las letras del alfabeto para que cada usuario pueda crear sus propias combinaciones y personalizar completamente el resultado final.

description: Anime Statue Series — Gabriel (Daemons of the Shadow Realm) Ultra-Real High-Capacity Storage Box 1. Concept & Design Following our tradition of bringing overwhelming anime menace into tangible reality, we turn our focus to one of the most visually striking and unsettling entities from Daemons of the Shadow Realm — Gabriel . This creation is not merely a static biological sculpture; it is a flawless fusion of high-end artistic presence and daily utility—introducing the Gabriel Ultra-Real High-Capacity Storage Box . Breaking away from boring, hard geometric boxes, this piece materializes Gabriel's chaotic nature: a jet-black form covered in an erratic array of staring eyes, paired with an iconic, razor-sharp open maw. It is built with an exaggerated organic tension, leaving a motionless yet unstable, living-alloy aura on your desk. Every contour is crafted to balance eerie nostalgia, dark expression, and genuine centerpiece impact. 2. Engineering & Printing Guide (Important: Multi-Color Recommendation) The storage box is meticulously engineered for maximum stability in large-scale FDM printing, ensuring long-term utility and print success. However, regarding the printing workflow and engineering structure, please read the following notes carefully: No "No-AMS" Parted Design This Time: I intentionally did not create a split-part, single-color version for this model. Through rigorous testing, I found that trying to manually insert and glue the countless eyeballs, tiny pupils, and interlocking sharp teeth post-print would be an absolute nightmare of tolerance frustration and pain for everyone involved. Time Efficiency Analysis: More importantly, my print benchmarks reveal that the difference between a solid single-color print and a full AMS multi-color print is only about 10 hours . Trading 10 hours of print time to completely bypass the agonizing hell of manual assembly is an incredible bargain. Therefore, I highly recommend that we don't overcomplicate things— let’s just go full multi-color directly together! Monolithic High-Strength Ballast Structure: This storage box utilizes a one-piece, permanently open static maw structure rather than an articulated lid. The rear spinal support and the base footprint are heavily reinforced for center-of-gravity compensation. Even when packed to the brim with heavy items like hardware or keys, the statue remains rock-solid and perfectly stable whenever you drop items into its jaw. 3. Display & Functionality As showcased in the product photos, Gabriel’s aggressive, wide-open jaw serves as an apex predator for desk clutter. It pairs beautifully as a functional storage solution for: Keys, USB drives, EDC rings, and loose hardware/screws. Tangled charging cables, or even hosting a small LED puck light inside (as seen in the pictures, the internal ambient glow pushes the biomechanical cosmic dread to the absolute limit). Whether stationed on your primary workstation or a hallway console, its aggressive silhouette featured across multiple angles delivers supreme stylized plausibility and unrivaled shelf presence. 4. Conclusion The Gabriel Hyper-Real Storage Box proves that catastrophic charm and immense visual impact don't have to sacrifice functional purpose. By choosing direct multi-color printing, it allows the madness of its gaze, grotesque aesthetics, and surreal realism to freeze flawlessly into a centerpiece that completely dominates the space it commands. Quick Tips: Avoid using photography/timelapse travel modes for this print to minimize failure risks around the deep overhangs and heavy back panel structures. Calibrate your flow rate properly and ensure your filament is completely dry—Bambu gray and black remain my absolute go-to filaments. Needle-nose pliers combined with Bambu’s FAC002-N scraper make clearing supports from the tight crevices of the teeth incredibly efficient.

Yes, I’m insane. Regular-sized figures and statues just aren’t my thing - So I modelled Batman from scratch and printed him…life sized. After printing, assembling and painting, I gave him a batcape, glass eyes, metal screwhead details and a glossy surface finish for his metal parts. I modelled him after the design in the arkham origins game because I think this is one of the sickest batsuit designs. Who agrees? If you happen to be equally crazy as I am and to actually download and print your own life-sized statue, here’s a few additional information: Print overview Batman himself consists of 40 parts which can be printed on every Bambu printer except for the A1 mini. His accessories on the belt as well as the batarang add another 11 parts making it a total of 51 parts. To identify each part, I created a general overview below. You can identify each part in the print profiles too - I named the print bed labels and the parts on it according to the overview. Because Bambu Studio won’t let me create more than 36 plates, I divided the parts into “Lower body”, “Torso & Head” and “Shoulders, arms & Accessories”. Each print profile has its own overview with the parts it contains. Assembling, Post-processing For assembling, there’s no connectors, screw holes or anything like that - Like a typical cosplay prop, the print itself just serves as the base and is then further refined, making the seams invisible and giving it a nice finish which will also hold everything together properly. I used a heated sculpting tool called Modifi3D to melt the seams together, which added a lot of strength already while also making the seams barely noticeable. And from this point on, it’s entirely up to you how far you want to take the surface finishing process. I coated everything in fiberglass which was a sh!tload of work but it really paid off in terms of both durability and appearance. And because there’s so many different ways, techniques and methods for the entire post-process, there’s no right or wrong when it comes to slicing and printing. I printed everything without infill and without top- or bottom surface (with a few exceptions), leaving the parts hollow, made of 6 wall loops. Sort of a vase mode. Adjust the parameters to your liking. Really curious to see if there’s ANYONE who will actually go for this project. And if so, I need pictures! If you appreciate my work, would you mind boosting me so I can reduce the financial damage on this insane project? 👉👈

description: Xenomorph (Alien) Ultra Detailed Display This one is by far one of my largest, and definitely the most detailed model that I've worked on to date.. This is an Ultra Detailed Xenomorph statue that stands 19 inches (48cm) tall in the largest form! This statue pulls inspiration from the unbelievably awesome Sideshow Collectibles Vinyl model, which if you are familiar with their models, are next level in detail.. but next to impossible to get! There are 2 size profiles being made available at the time of the model upload - 19" tall version as well as a 10" tall version. Please note that the 19" tall version is printed in pieces, and is maximized in size to fit the P/X series printer beds. The 10" tall version is printed a simplified one-piece print. I should know that I have printed 6 different size variants and will note that you can easily scale this between 10" and 19" tall models. **Please be aware that the print times are lengthy. I had 4 machines running test prints none stop. I promise though, it is worth it at the end. **Please also be aware that the model images you see are 100% real, with 0 use of AI, but they have been post-process colored using some Rub'n Buff waxes, along with some gloss clear coat layer application at the end. ASSEMBLY REQUIRED ** The 19" tall, multipiece print will require some glue. I have used both super glue, as well as hot glue. Hot glue was my preference. With all the parts printed, and supports cleaned up (TAKE YOUR TIME REMOVING THE SUPPORTS AS THE PARTS ARE HIGHLY DETAILED AND FRAGILE ) do a dry-fit of all the parts to ensure proper fitment. You may need to file down some pieces if they do not fit. All 4 of my models went together with no issues, but different printers/filaments may have some tolerance issues. Assembly is very straightfoward, with the exception of the tail. DO NOT mount the tail to the model until the Xenomoprh is placed onto the base display. The tail loops around the display and needs to be installed afterwards. Install the tail by turning is 90 degrees and carefully looping the tip around the back of the base and then gently rotating it up into the reciever cutout on he back of the xenomorph (Yes, it looks like a butt ). With the Dry fitting completed, if you are satisfied with the fitment you can take the piees apart and proceed to glue them together. As with the above test-fit process, you can assemble everything together, just leave the tail to the end. If you are planning to paint/apply color to the model I highly advise doing so with Xenomorph OFF of the base. For final assembly, apply some glue to the foot mounting peg as well as some glue to the toes of the left foot (there is no peg here) and firmly place the model on to the base. Proceed with snaking the tail into position, and then apply some glue onto the peg of the base of the tail. There is a small mounting support for the tail at the back of the base that also requires a small application of glue to help it from bouncing around with the model fully assembled. COLOR APPLICATION I used a very straightforward process for my coloring via application of some Rub'n Buff Antique Gold wax for the Xenomorph, and Brass color for the base. Wear gloves and apply the wax to a towel and gently go over the details. Avoid pressing really hard so that the void remain black/dark, this helps with final contrast of the model. As you can tell from these two photos the difference between the plain model and the colored one is pretty phenomenal and I HIGHLY recommend going through the effort!

description: Mecha Pokémon Statue Series — Mecha Lugia Hyper-Real Steel Sculpture 1. Concept & Design Following our tradition of heavy mechanical re-forging (Mecha Reforge) applied to iconic anime characters, we turn our focus to the legendary Guardian of the Seas from the Johto region— Lugia . This creation reimagines Lugia’s streamlined biological form through the lens of heavy industrial and military cyberpunk aesthetics. Moving away from low-detail smooth surfaces, the majesty of the diving sea god is materialized here as a dense, armored exoskeleton statue. Its roaring headline pose, the intricate neck cables alongside exposed hydraulic pistons, and the layered plating of the heavy chest armor exude an organic living-alloy tension and pure mechanical menace. Its iconic hands-like wings are re-engineered into heavy military-grade thruster wings, complete with articulated mechanical joints and individual aerodynamic slats. In this static stance, the signature dorsal plates running down to the tail are transformed into rigid external cooling fins, conveying a supreme sense of compressed energy beneath the armor. It commands an unparalleled centerpiece presence on any desk. 2. Engineering & Printability The statue is meticulously engineered for maximum stability in large-scale FDM printing, striking a perfect balance between hyper-dense mechanical detail and a reliable printing experience: Center-of-Gravity & Ballast Compensation: Due to Lugia's wide wingspan and heavy tail, the lower body volume has been strategically redistributed. The thick mechanical legs significantly increase the footprint surface area, working in tandem with the elongated segmented tail to form a rock-solid triangular base. Monolithic One-Shot Design: This model prints as a single static statue piece with no articulated joints or complex part segmentations, completely eliminating assembly tolerance alignment issues or loose fittings. Exceptional Geometric Readability: At 0.2 mm layer heights, the intricate armor panel lines, bolts, gears, and exposed wiring naturally catch the light, throwing deep dual-density shadows. Even straight off the build plate in solid gray filament, it delivers immense premium depth without immediate post-painting. 3. Display & Customization With its aggressive, expansive wingspan, Mecha Lugia naturally thrives in workbench displays, tactical mecha bays, or post-apocalyptic industrial backdrops. For advanced statue painters and makers, the model offers limitless creative room for custom finishing: It perfectly welcomes heavy weathering, dry-brush metallic chipping, or oil-slick griming. Adding a bright cyan or neon purple inner bloom paint inside the neck conduits, eye sockets, or chest core lines simulates an imminent "Aeroblast" energy charge. Whether positioned as your primary workstation centerpiece or a photography backdrop, its silhouette delivers supreme stylized plausibility and unrivaled shelf presence. 4. Conclusion The Hyper-Real Mecha Lugia statue stands as a definitive showcase piece for mecha enthusiasts and print collectors who adore stylized plausibility and catastrophic charm. It transforms a childhood legend into tangible awe—blending weight, sharp armor geometry, and frozen motion into one essential collector’s centerpiece that completely dominates the space it commands. Quick Tips: Avoid using photography/timelapse travel modes for this print to minimize stringing or failure risks around the heavy wing overhangs and dense back fins. Calibrate your flow rate properly and ensure your filament is completely dry—Bambu gray remains my absolute go-to filament for reading mechanical details flawlessly. Needle-nose pliers combined with Bambu’s FAC002-N scraper make clearing support structures from the tight crevices of the mechanical wings incredibly efficient.

model_name: Mecha Pokemon Series — Beedrill Hyper-Real Statue
description: Mecha Pokémon Statue Series — Mecha Beedrill Hyper-Real Steel Sculpture 1. Concept & Design This sculpture reinterprets the iconic, lethal airborne assassin through the lens of heavy mechanical re-forging (Mecha Reforge). As the newest chapter of our "Mecha Pokémon Series," we turn our focus to the legendary high-speed apex predator of the Kanto region— Beedrill . This creation reimagines Beedrill’s aggressive biological silhouette into a heavy armored exoskeleton statue brimming with industrial rigidity. The design transforms its naturally lightweight abdomen and segments into layered, curved armor plates packed with dense mechanical panel lines, exuding immense physical mass and weaponized tension within a static warrior pose. Structurally, due to Beedrill's defining biological trait of having extremely small feet , achieving balance in large-scale monolithic FDM printing posed a significant challenge. To counter this, we engineered the right arm to drive its massive lance directly into the ground , establishing a rock-solid triangular base. However, this required a compromise: visually, it looks as though half of Beedrill's iconic twin stingers are missing. To fix this, we included an extra loose lance accessory just for you guys ! This bonus lance gives you complete display freedom—you can hang it on the raised left hand to create a gripping effect, holding it facing forward or backward. (Note: If you wish to completely lift it overhead, you will need to utilize an aftermarket action figure display stand for support). Of course, you can also get creative and print multiple extra lances to scatter around him, replicating an epic "infinite weapon arsenal" scene from certain anime series (lol). 2. Engineering & Printability The statue is highly optimized for large-scale FDM stability, prioritizing ballast physics and center-of-gravity compensation over part articulation: Support Removal & Structural Integrity: The primary printing hurdle with this model is that the supports beneath both arms are somewhat tricky to remove , requiring patience. On the flip side, the supports for the wings detach very easily. However, because the joint area connecting the wings to the main body is quite small , please handle them with care during cleanup so you don't accidentally snap the entire wing section off. The remaining parts should be smooth sailing for experienced makers. Minor Artifact Correction: If your print suffers from a slightly warped or misaligned pinky finger on the left hand , there's no need to scrap the print. Simply use a heat gun to gently soften the plastic, realign it, and secure it with a drop of glue. Geometric Shadow Readability: At 0.2 mm layer heights, the mechanical compound eyes, the layered armor on the torso, and the sweeping taper of the giant lances catch ambient light perfectly, throwing deep dual-density shadows that eliminate the absolute need for immediate painting. 3. Display & Customization With its sweeping, aggressive wingspan, Mecha Beedrill naturally commands a premium presence when staged inside industrial mecha bays, barren desert ruins, or post-apocalyptic military outposts. For advanced miniature painters and makers, the model offers limitless creative room for custom finishing: The expansive metal surfaces are perfectly suited for heavy weathering, grease-staining, and metallic edge dry-brushing. The deep recesses between the armor plates and the main lances are ideal for dropping high-contrast vivid hive-amber or neon toxic-green paints to simulate a lethal weapon system charging up. By printing several extra copies of the lance and staking them into a custom clay or foam terrain base, you can flawlessly recreate a "Gate of Babylon" styled boundless armory effect that dramatically elevates the visual impact. Whether positioned as a standalone desk centerpiece or integrated into a sci-fi diorama, its silhouette delivers superb stylized plausibility from every angle. 4. Conclusion The Hyper-Real Mecha Beedrill statue stands as a definitive showcase piece, proving that high collectible impact isn't born from moving parts, but from raw sculptural presence. It transforms a childhood memory into tangible awe—blending menace, mass, and sharp industrial geometry into an essential collector’s centerpiece that completely dominates the space it commands. Quick Tips: Avoid using photography/timelapse travel modes for this print to minimize stringing or failure risks around the delicate antennae and sweeping wing overhangs. Crucial Warning: If you plan on using a mini-torch or a heat gun to clear stringing and print residue from the wings, remember that the wings are extremely thin—please exercise extreme caution ! To prevent the thin geometry from softening and warping instantly upon heating, it is highly recommended to steady the wing with one hand while keeping the heat source moving rapidly. My absolute go-to filament for reading these industrial mechanical details remains the Bambu Lab gray series . When removing tight supports from beneath the arms, needle-nose pliers combined with Bambu’s FAC002-N scraper will be your ultimate soulmates.

description: “Tre versioni di Batman, tre anime diverse, un solo cavaliere oscuro.” Porta nella tua collezione un set davvero unico con questo trio di Batman in stile chibi , reinterpretato in tre varianti originali e ricche di personalità: Samurai, Mecha e Tactical Gas Mask . Ogni figura mantiene l’identità iconica del Cavaliere Oscuro, ma la reinterpreta in una chiave completamente diversa. Da una parte troviamo il Batman samurai , con armatura ispirata al Giappone feudale e un look da guerriero oscuro. Dall’altra c’è il Batman tactical con maschera antigas , perfetto per un’estetica più post-apocalittica e militare. Al centro, invece, una versione più corazzata e futuristica , con un design che richiama uno stile mecha / armored . Lo stile chibi rende il set ancora più speciale: teste grandi, corpi compatti, dettagli marcati e una resa simpatica ma allo stesso tempo intimidatoria. Il risultato è un mix perfetto tra cute collectible e dark hero design , ideale per mensole, scrivanie, setup gaming e collezioni dedicate ai supereroi. Stampati in nero opaco , come nella foto, i tre modelli assumono un look premium e molto scenografico. Il monocolore valorizza silhouette, armature, maschere, mantelli e accessori, rendendo il set perfetto anche senza pittura. Per chi ama il post-processing, invece, ci sono tantissime possibilità per creare versioni ancora più epiche e personalizzate. Questo set è perfetto per chi cerca qualcosa di diverso dal classico Batman: tre varianti da collezione, tutte con un’identità forte e immediatamente riconoscibile.

description: Batman Noir - The Perched Sentinel Introducing Batman Noir - The Perched Sentinel , the second model in my new Noir Ledge Series ! This dramatic ledge model captures the Dark Knight in a powerful crouched pose on a long straight rooftop ledge. One hand grips the edge and is designed to overhang for perfect natural balance on a shelf, while the other is clenched in a tight fist. His iconic long cape flows dramatically over the ledge, creating an imposing silhouette. Key features: Fully multipart design with easy snap-fit assembly → no glue required No AMS needed (AMS options available for some color accents or no assembly hassle if you want them) Optimized for single-filament printing while still offering multicolor flexibility on select parts Dramatic shelf display → place it on the edge so the hand overhangs for that perfect “watching over the city” look This model pairs beautifully with Spider Noir - The Perched Phantom and looks incredible alongside my signature Eagle collection (as shown in the photos). Build your own dark heroic display! Print profile 100% scale = From the bottom of the feet to the top of the head, the height is about 121 mm, which matches the Spider-Noir height. Layer Height : 0.08-0.2 mm Walls : 2–3 Infill : 5–30% (uses lower end for large parts to save filament/time; higher end for small/functional parts and connectors to boost durability and prevent breakage during repeated assembly/disassembly) Speed: Small parts operate at a slower speed than other parts. Supports : Tree supports are automatically generated and manually painted on various parts to improve print reliability. The cape is printed with support paints for a more reliable print. The face is printed with support paints for a seamless connection to the head, minimizing gaps. Color Handling : Multipart design → no AMS required. Print plates separately in desired filaments. You can also rearrange the parts onto different plates if you want to mix the colors in a more unique way. Options: Print plates 1-6 or replace some parts with AMS options. In my photos the belt is printed with AMS option. Plates Assembly Instructions This multipart model is designed for effortless, glueless assembly! Snap everything together using the peg connectors. No glue required for a secure, satisfying fit. Preparation Carefully remove tree supports before assembly. Tree supports release most cleanly when cut between branches… snap them away without stressing surfaces. Peg Connections Almost all parts use the same snap-fit peg system Pegs are intentionally tight for rock-solid hold → align and then push firmly until you feel/hear the snap. If too tight → lightly trim peg domes (green). If slightly loose → a tiny drop of superglue fixes it instantly. Smaller pegs may feel less "clicky" than larger ones but still provide reliable strength. Insert the eyes with the flat side facing outward, and you might need to snap it into place using some tool. Attach the cape first, then secure it by adding the head, which locks it in place. If the head doesn’t snap into place easily, wiggle the cap or upper body a bit while pushing. description: Goku SSJ2: Smart Multi-Part Design This figure represents Goku in his Super Saiyan 2 phase . Unlike traditional models that print as a single block, this design is fully segmented into independent parts, including the hair, head, torso, arms, pants, belt, and boots. This structural division simplifies both the printing process and the final finishing, eliminating the need to paint complex layers onto a single, solid surface. The model is specifically designed so you do not have to rely on expensive multi-material technologies like Bambu Lab's AMS . Because each element is separate, you can organize your build plates by color and print all pieces sharing the same tone together using the final colored filament directly (such as orange for the pants and torso, or yellow for the hair). This approach completely eliminates purge towers and the material waste generated by changing filaments on the same layer, resulting in significant savings of both time and plastic. Furthermore, it makes the model 100% compatible with any standard 3D printer on the market. Assembly is clean and precise thanks to a built-in system of connecting pins and custom-fit guide cavities. This male-female mechanism ensures that each part aligns geometrically and accurately, removing any risk of the limbs or head being rotated or crooked. You do not need screws or complex tools to permanently assemble the figure; all you need is cyanoacrylate glue (classic instant adhesive or Super Glue). The process is straightforward: first, perform a dry fit by assembling the parts to verify they fit properly and to clean away any remaining support material. Next, apply a single drop of glue to the connecting pin, press both parts firmly together for 10 to 15 seconds, and the structure will be completely secure.

description: This sculpture is made of 2 separate models. Current height; Angel - ~22cm, (8.66") and the Demon ~24 cm (9.45") The idea behind The Pull of Temptation was to create two complete opposites—something you know is probably not good for you, but is still incredibly hard to resist. I also wanted to play around with the question: Who is really tempting who? The devil is lifting the angel’s chin, but she almost looks like she is kissing—or smirking against—his thumb. At the same time, she is clutching her dress, almost as if she is trying to hold herself back. The devil is close, but he is not quite touching her. So in the end, who is actually tempting who? I wanted this sculpture to be on the taller side, but with the height comes a longer print time and more challenging supports around the angels hair. I have not tried printing either figure at a smaller size. It is very possible that you could ease up on the supports if you scale them down, but at the current size, I would not recommend using anything weaker than the included settings. Printing Use a clean print plate with some glue (unless you are using a super tack plate) Use dried out filament (Different filament types impact the print differently, please adjust your settings accordingly. If printing with silk PLA, then I recommend to adjust the Speed Outer wall setting to 40mm/s and Tope Surface to 40mm/s. Leave each model on the dedicated print plate, they don't share the same support settings. Support Removal Let the model cool down before removing the supports. Use pliers when removing the supports. Start with breaking the support in the middle by “crushing” them by using a plier. Start with the larger outside supports first, then carefully work your way into the chair area using small pliers around the wings, head and arms etc. For the Black Angel, gently pull/wiggle the support down following the direction of the wings/spikes. For the White Angel - The support is nestled under and might be in the hair and will take a little bit extra time. I added support blockers where possible, but I could not block everything. You may find that a few small support branches need to remain in place. They should not be noticeable from a normal viewing. Sanding and gentle heating might be needed under the wing edges and under the chin of both of the models. If applying heat be careful to avoid warping or damaging the print. Este diseño de mariposa está pensado para ser una pieza versátil que puede servir como una delicada decoración o como un marcapáginas único. El modelo está diseñado específicamente para ser impreso directamente sobre tela de tul, lo que le otorga un fondo transparente y una textura muy especial. Instrucciones de Impresión (Técnica sobre tela) Para lograr que la mariposa quede adherida a la tela, es necesario seguir un proceso de impresión con pausa. Aquí están los pasos clave: Pausa programada: El archivo de impresión debe configurarse en el laminador (slicer) para que genere una pausa automática exactamente al terminar la primera capa . Colocación de la tela: Durante esta pausa, el cabezal se apartará. Es el momento de colocar la tela de tul estirada sobre la cama de impresión, justo por encima de la capa base que se acaba de imprimir. Fijación con imanes: Para evitar que el cabezal arrastre la tela o se formen arrugas, utiliza imanes en los bordes para fijar el tul firmemente a la base metálica de la impresora. Asegúrate de que los imanes queden fuera de la trayectoria del extrusor. Reanudación de la impresión: Una vez que la tela esté tensa y asegurada, reanuda la impresión. El plástico de las siguientes capas se fundirá a través de los agujeros de la malla del tul, encapsulando la tela y uniendo el diseño de forma permanente.

The Story Born in the neon-shadowed depths of a dystopian megacity, Aegis-01 is a cybernetic operative engineered for elite infiltration and tactical defense. Print Settings & Tips Layer Height: 0.12 mm (Recommended for maximum detail retention). You can print at 0.20 mm to save time, but some of the finer mechanical suit details will lose sharpness at this scale. Scale: 14 cm tall. Infill: 8% Gyroid (Perfect balance of structural strength and material savings). Orientation: Print upside down! This orientation significantly optimizes support generation, protects the delicate finger details from fusing, and ensures the cleanest possible surfaces on the upper body. CRITICAL SUPPORT REMOVAL & BED ADHESION INFO: Do not aggressively rip or pull the supports directly off. Instead, pinch or cut them halfway through using a small flush cutter (side cutter) to create a weak fracture line. Once scored, they will snap off effortlessly without scarring the model. Additionally, make sure your build plate is thoroughly cleaned with IPA before starting—excellent first-layer adhesion is crucial for printing this upside down. description: This print can be used to turn a flat printed plate / flag into a wavy flag. Printing the flag in the flat orientation greatly speeds up the print and prevents so many filament changes in multicolor prints that waste filament. I have a few hundred flags available on under my models and collections to organize them a bit. Print the forms in ABS or PETG so they are more temperature tolerant although PLA might work. Under my profile I have both a square flag pole Square Flag Pole by sage117 - MakerWorld and a round one Round Flag Pole by sage117 - MakerWorld , so you can choose whatever your preference is or print one of each to accompany your flag. ======================================================================================= Video of how to heat the flag and form it. Use a heat gun going back and forth over the plate several times until it starts to become soft and can get it to flex with your finger. Quickly take the top plate of the form and place it over. There is a little bit of a lip so can catch the plate and use to press it up to the top. This helps ensure the plate does not warp in the other direction and that get a flat bottom so does not wobble much when standing up. I left a slight gap at the top so once can see that the full length of the top is being pressed against the top of the bottom form plate. I use a clamp to hold the plates together and give it 5-10 minutes to cool off to ensure the plate keeps the shape as it cools.

Oxumaré é um orixá cultuado nas religiões de matriz africana, como o Candomblé e a Umbanda, reconhecido como a divindade do movimento, da transformação e da continuidade. Representado simultaneamente pela serpente e pelo arco-íris , ele atua como a grande ponte que liga o mundo material (Aiyê) ao mundo espiritual (Orum). Aqui estão os seus principais atributos: Domínios: Rege os ciclos vitais, as mudanças, as chuvas, a renovação e também está profundamente associado à riqueza e à prosperidade. Simbologia: A serpente (muitas vezes representada mordendo a própria cauda, como um ouroboros ) simboliza o ciclo infinito da vida, a regeneração e o movimento da terra. O arco-íris representa a aliança, a beleza e a comunicação fluida entre os seres humanos e os deuses. Dualidade: Oxumaré é célebre por sua natureza cíclica e dupla. Nas tradições, diz-se que ele passa metade do ano como arco-íris (no céu, em sua forma masculina ou celestial) e a outra metade como serpente (na terra, ligado à água e a energias que por vezes fluem para o feminino). Saudação: Arroboboi! (ou Arroboboi, Oxumaré! ), uma expressão de reverência e saudação à sua força. É um orixá fundamental para garantir que a vida não fique estagnada, mantendo o universo em constante movimento e transformação. Já está pronto para impressão. Otimizado para impressoras FDM. description: This is the third of four of Randy Rhoads guitars that I am working to release. The Sandoval Randy Rhoads Dot V guitar is such an icon. I worked my hardest to try and get the details right. This is also one of the easiest models from my collection to print and assemble. The flying V polka-dot guitar—better known as the Dot V —was custom-built in 1979 for Randy Rhoads by Karl Sandoval, and it became one of the most recognizable guitars in rock history. Here’s the short version of its story: The idea started with another custom V guitar. Randy saw a tiger-striped V that Sandoval had built for George Lynch and contacted Sandoval to make something of his own. Randy designed the concept himself. He wanted a guitar that combined: the feel of his 1972 Gibson Les Paul Custom the aggressive look of a Flying V a Fender-style tremolo bridge for expressive playing Sandoval worked with Randy directly to turn the sketches into a real instrument. The polka-dot finish was intentional, not random. Randy requested a black body with large white dots and bowtie fret inlays to visually match his stage clothes. Sandoval says the original had 275 dots , applied by hand through a labor-intensive finishing process. The hardware reflected the hot-rodding culture of late-1970s Southern California. The guitar used: a DiMarzio Super Distortion pickup in the bridge a DiMarzio PAF in the neck That setup helped create the high-output, articulate sound associated with Randy’s playing. It wasn’t originally built under a major brand. Randy specifically asked for no company logos on the guitar, which is one reason Sandoval’s contribution wasn’t widely recognized for years. The guitar became iconic after Randy joined Ozzy Osbourne. Once videos like Crazy Train reached audiences, the Dot V became inseparable from Randy’s image and helped define the visual identity of early metal guitar culture.

description: Make the best World Cup Trophy ever with a MOVA Globe that spins! No batteries! No wires! No magnets! HERE'S HOW to build your own amazing MOVA Globe World Cup Trophy: (assembly video will be posted to YouTube @MaskedMarble on June 25, 2026) 🛠️ Required Hardware & 10% Discount Alert To complete this World Cup Trophy, you need a 4.5" MOVA Globe (Earth with Clouds) . Important: Do not pay full retail price! A 10% off project discount code and the exact product purchase link are available for this build. Where to get the code: Due to platform rules, shopping codes cannot be listed on this page. To grab the active 10% discount code and the purchase link, visit my YouTube channel @MaskedMarble (linked directly on my MakerWorld Profile Page ) and check the description box of the assembly video for this project. ADDITIONAL MATERIALS NEEDED: Plaster of Paris - a 4 lb container is more than enough. I highly recommend not skipping the plaster. The plaster adds weight to the base and body which makes the trophy more stable. Remember, all the weight of the MOVA Globe is sitting on the very top. If the trophy is accidentally tipped, the MOVA Globe will fall out and could become damaged. Plaster in the base and body will counteract the weight of the globe to make the trophy more stable against tipping. A throwaway mixing/pouring cup for plaster of paris. I used a large plastic drive-thru drink cup. It helps if the cup is flexible, so you can pinch the cup at the lip to create a narrow channel for pouring plaster. Silk filament in gold and green/black colors. I used CC3D Silk Gold PLA and ELEGOO Silk PLA Dual Color Black & Green. The gold is used everywhere except for the two Malachite rings on the base. In nature, Malachite is a dark green with black lines running through it. Without trying to model those lines, I went with dual-color filament that looks green from one direction and black from another direction. Super glue (Cyanoacrylate) INSTRUCTIONS/ASSEMBLY: 3D print trophy and base. Multi-color print with or without AMS. Print settings are listed below. Place the base upside down on top of the trophy body (using the trophy as a temporary holder) and fill the base with plaster of paris. I mixed 2 cups plaster of paris powder with 1 cup water, and that was plenty. Do not pour the plaster level with the top of the hole, because plaster of paris slightly expands during curing. Leave a little space below top of hole to avoid protruding plaster that could scratch the table or cause base to sit unlevel. Allow plaster to set fully (usually 30 minutes). Use super glue (Cyanoacrylate) to attach the 3D-printed trophy body to the top of the base, taking note of the alignment keys. To fully lock the trophy to the weighted base, mix more plaster of paris and pour into the trophy top hole. Do not fill higher than 0.5 to 1 inch below the top, as the spherical MOVA Globe sits lower than the hole edges. Use damp paper towels to wipe off all residual plaster powder and spills on the curved surfaces where the MOVA Globe will sit…you don't want to scratch the globe's acrylic surface! It will take 3 days or so for excess moisture in the plaster of paris to evaporate. During that time, do not place the trophy upright on a surface that could be damaged by moisture, like a wood table. It is best to lay the assembled trophy on its side while the plaster is drying. The plaster will feel cool to the touch if water is still evaporating . Place trophy upright and place MOVA Globe on top. The MOVA Globe sits snugly inside, but is not firmly attached to the trophy, allowing the globe to be removed and used with other bases. PLEASE BE MINDFUL: The MOVA Globe is not attached to the trophy! Do not tilt the trophy or hoist it over your head when your favorite team wins the World Cup…the MOVA Globe will fall out! WARNING: Until the plaster is completely dry, do not place the trophy on wood surfaces that could be damaged by excess moisture. Drying can take 3 days or longer. PRINT SETTINGS: Prints without supports. Print trophy base with AMS (2 color), or print without AMS by placing pauses at color changes. You will only need to make 3 filament swaps. 0.8mm layer height makes for an awesome finish with silk PLA Gyroid pattern for sparse infill is best, because it keeps the printhead from colliding with perpendicular filament it has already laid, especially at the tallest layers of the trophy model. You don't want your 3D print separating from the bed Print with 3 wall loops. Seam position: back Recommend printing with textured PEI plate. Glue can be added to ensure print does not separate while printing. THE REMIX: I made changes to the base so that it could be printed without supports, and corrected the bottom gold layer on the outside to look like the real trophy. I added an indentation ring as a demarcation between the bottom-most gold and malachite rings. The bottom hole is now large enough to pour plaster, but not so large that a cover is needed. Internal posts are added to anchor the plaster. I also scaled up the model and cut out a 122mm sphere to perfectly fit the 4.5" MOVA Globe (the globe is technically 122mm in diameter, but is marketed as 4.5" diameter). I also added to the base's central post so that the plaster of Paris poured into the trophy body will lock the trophy and base together. Lastly, there was extensive work done to build out the back of the sculpture hands so that they are maximum thickness and won't break off.

description: Ryuk ( Death Note ) Ryuk è uno Shinigami (un dio della morte) annoiato ed eccentrico, proveniente da una dimensione desolata e grigia. Per spezzare la monotonia del suo mondo, decide deliberatamente di far cadere il suo "Quaderno della Morte" ( Death Note ) sulla Terra, dando inizio agli eventi della serie. Aspetto Fisico: È una creatura imponente, alta e magra, dai tratti grotteschi e umanoidi. Ha una pelle pallida dalle sfumature grigio-azzurre, grandi occhi gialli e sporgenti con pupille rosse, e una bocca perennemente cucita in un sorriso inquietante e affilato. I suoi capelli sono neri, corti e sparati verso l'alto. Abbigliamento: Indossa un abito aderente di colore scuro, simile a pelle strappata o bende gotiche, arricchito da anelli, bracciali e una vistosa cintura decorata con teschi e catene metalliche. Sulla schiena porta enormi ali piumate nere, simili a quelle di un corvo, che può ritrarre a piacimento. Personalità e Vizi: Ryuk non è intrinsecamente malvagio, ma agisce puramente come un osservatore neutrale guidato dal proprio intrattenimento. Ha una profonda e totale dipendenza dalle mele del mondo umano , che per lui sono l'equivalente di una droga o dell'alcol (e la cui mancanza gli provoca vere e proprie crisi di astinenza). Descrizione delle Immagini (Modello 3D) Le immagini mostrano il modello tridimensionale di una statua da collezione ultra-dettagliata, concepita per la stampa 3D, catturata da quattro angolazioni differenti (frontale, posteriore, profilo sinistro e profilo destro) per mostrare la continuità e la coerenza della scultura senza alcuna modifica strutturale. 1. Visuale Frontale Ryuk è raffigurato in una posa accovacciata e dinamica. La gamba destra è piegata stretta al petto, mentre la gamba sinistra è distesa lateralmente verso l'esterno, creando un forte senso di asimmetria. Con la mano sinistra solleva una mela rossa lucida, portandola vicina al volto come se stesse per morderla, mentre il braccio destro è teso verso il basso, con le lunghe dita artigliate che sfiorano la base. Le ali sono spiegate lateralmente in tutta la loro ampiezza, incorniciando il personaggio. 2. Visuale Posteriore Dalla prospettiva posteriore emerge l'incredibile dettaglio anatomico e materico della scultura. L'attenzione è catturata dalla texture piumata delle grandi ali grigio-scuro, dove ogni singola piuma è scolpita individualmente. Al centro della schiena è visibile la complessa imbracatura di cinghie e fibbie metalliche. Si notano anche i dettagli del retro della cintura, con la catena metallica e il teschio ornamentale che ricadono sul fianco. 3. Visuali Laterali (Profili Sinistro e Destro) I profili mostrano la marcata sporgenza della colonna vertebrale e la postura vistosamente gobba, tipica del personaggio. Da un lato (sinistro del personaggio) si apprezza la linea del braccio che porta la mela alla bocca e la forte angolazione del ginocchio piegato; dall'altro lato (destro del personaggio) si evidenzia la tensione del braccio destro teso all'indù e la linea slanciata della gamba sinistra distesa. La Base della Statua Ryuk è seduto sopra una ricca catasta di ossa umane, teschi e gabbie toraciche accumulati alla rinfusa. Questa piramide di scheletri racchiude perfettamente l'atmosfera macabra del mondo degli Shinigami: le ossa servono proprio per fare scena , conferendo drammaticità, stabilità strutturale alla figura e un forte impatto gotico all'intera composizione da qualsiasi angolazione la si guardi.

description: This is a 150 mm standing Catholic crucifix designed as a cleaner, easier print. The model separates the crucifix body from the base so the main cross section can be printed more efficiently with fewer major supports and less cleanup. The finished piece has a traditional devotional look with a sculpted corpus, INRI plaque, rectangular cross, and a stable display base. A stone, marble, or matte PLA gives a carved-statue look. Remove supports gently from the figure with flush cutters; a quick pass with a soft brush cleans up the interface marks. Print the stand in the same or a contrasting color. Optional: even easier support removal (AMS / multi-material If you have an AMS or a second filament, you can make the supports practically fall off. PETG doesn't bond to PLA, so using it only for the support interface gives a clean break with a smooth surface underneath: In Bambu Studio, open the Support tab. Set Interface filament to a slot loaded with PETG (keep the rest of the supports/body as PLA). Make sure there's a small support gap (the included profile already uses 0.16mm) and re-slice. Print as normal — the PLA body lifts right off the PETG interface. This is fully optional. The default single-PLA profile already releases cleanly; the PETG trick just makes cleanup even nicer if you have the filament on hand. description: Cyberwolf: Born from the Digital Wilderness In a world where nature and cybernetic future collide, a new apex predator emerges. This isn't a creature born of flesh and bone, but a synthesis of sharp algorithms, organic textures, and bold design. This model perfectly captures the duality of the Cyberwolf. Supports: Tree Supports — Used to gently cradle the low-hanging areas and the complex sci-fi base, ensuring effortless removal and a flawless surface finish. Material: PLA Gray — The neutral gray tone is perfect for showcasing mechanical details, catching shadows beautifully along the model's facets. Print Time: 2 hours and 15 minutes — A fast, rewarding print that brings a high-fidelity sci-fi figure to life in just one sitting. Support Removal: Because of the tree supports, they should pop right off. Start from the base and gently work your way up to the wolf's body to prevent snapping the legs. Download, slice, and let the Cyberwolf hunt on your printer!

description: Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. The result is a durable and eye-catching 3D design that combines modern 3D printing technology with fashion. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. Do not tumble dry at high temperatures. ⚠️ Washing or drying at excessive temperatures may cause the 3D print to loosen or peel from the fabric over time.

description: 《软绒星瞳》是一枚以“治愈系萌宠”为灵感的雕塑戒指，它将猫咪的软萌与戒指的佩戴性完美结合，打造出一款兼具艺术感与治愈感的独特饰品。戒指同样采用奶白色哑光材质打造，质感温润细腻，自带柔和的柔光效果，仿佛被赋予了温度，上手后自带温柔的氛围感。 戒指的核心设计，是一只从戒环中探出脑袋的软萌猫咪。猫咪的造型采用了全立体雕刻，从毛茸茸的脸颊、尖俏的耳朵，到圆溜溜的眼睛、粉嫩的小鼻子，再到探出戒环的两只小肉垫，每一处细节都刻画得栩栩如生。猫咪的毛发纹理细腻逼真，层层叠叠的绒毛雕刻，让它看起来软乎乎的，仿佛伸手就能摸到它蓬松的毛；圆溜溜的眼睛温润透亮，没有多余的装饰，却自带无辜又灵动的眼神，像藏着星光一样，自带治愈感；两只肉垫搭在戒环上，肉垫的弧度与纹理都被精心还原，仿佛猫咪正乖乖趴在你的指尖撒娇，可爱感拉满。戒环的内侧同样打磨光滑，佩戴时贴合指腹，圆润的边缘不会硌手，兼顾了可爱造型与佩戴的舒适感。 这枚戒指的设计，藏着关于陪伴与治愈的温柔寓意。猫咪象征着陪伴与治愈，而这枚戒指就像一只永远趴在你指尖的小猫咪，无论何时何地，都能给你带来温柔的慰藉。它打破了传统饰品的刻板印象，将萌宠元素与雕塑艺术结合，打造出独一无二的风格，无论是日常通勤搭配休闲装，还是搭配甜酷风、温柔风的穿搭，都能轻松适配，让你的指尖自带一份软萌又高级的氛围感。 English: "Starry-Eyed Kitten" is a sculptural ring inspired by the "healing charm of pets". Cats symbolize companionship and healing, and this ring acts as a forever kitten perched on your finger, offering gentle solace wherever you go. Breaking away from traditional jewelry tropes, it combines cute elements with sculptural art for a truly unique style. Versatile enough for everyday casual wear, sweet-and-cool looks, or soft feminine styles, it adds a touch of whimsical luxury to any outfit.

description: Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. The result is a durable and eye-catching 3D design that combines modern 3D printing technology with fashion. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. Do not tumble dry at high temperatures. ⚠️ Washing or drying at excessive temperatures may cause the 3D print to loosen or peel from the fabric over time.

Summary A lightweight, ultra‑compact and efficient system designed to lock your shoelaces without tying a knot . Perfect for running shoes, sneakers, work shoes, or anyone who wants a clean, knot‑free look. 🔧 How It Works The lace follows a three‑step guided path: Central Hole The lace enters the main 4.1 mm hole, which keeps the lock aligned with the shoe’s eyelet. description: Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. The result is a durable and eye-catching 3D design that combines modern 3D printing technology with fashion. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. Do not tumble dry at high temperatures. ⚠️ Washing or drying at excessive temperatures may cause the 3D print to loosen or peel from the fabric over time.

Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. The result is a durable and eye-catching 3D design that combines modern 3D printing technology with fashion. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. Do not tumble dry at high temperatures. ⚠️ Washing or drying at excessive temperatures may cause the 3D print to loosen or peel from the fabric over time.

description: Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. The result is a durable and eye-catching 3D design that combines modern 3D printing technology with fashion. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. Do not tumble dry at high temperatures. ⚠️ Washing or drying at excessive temperatures may cause the 3D print to loosen or peel from the fabric over time.

I've been really wanting to try out iron-on t-shirt printing since the first time I saw it on Bambu. I decided on this fun design that I saw on Temu a while back. This was printed onto parchment paper that was secured to the plate with magnets and tape (on the back side), with Elmer's glue for additional adhesion (it washes off after). Please read the recommendations and instructions below carefully - they are crucial for a great print. It was a few iterations to find the right way to print this, so here are my recommendations: Only Ever Use TPU Filament: Do not attempt this with PLA or PETG. TPU (Thermoplastic Polyurethane) is a flexible rubber that acts exactly like a hot-melt adhesive when ironed, allowing it to permanently fuse into the fabric fibers. Rigid plastics will not bond correctly and will shatter or peel right off the shirt Go with Exactly 1 Layer: Scale your model's Z-height to 0.3mm and match your initial layer height to it. ( prevents the nozzle from dragging and it won't be heavy on the T-shirt ) Crawl the Speeds: Parchment paper has zero traction. You must restrict all slicer speed settings to force a slow, consistent crawl. Cap your Initial Layer Infill , Gap Infill , Outer/Inner Walls , and Top Surface all down to 20–30 mm/s . Dial in Retractions & Z-Hop: Enable a Normal Z-Hop (0.4mm) so the toolhead lifts straight up like an elevator between letters instead of dragging strings. Increase your retraction length to 1.2mm–1.5mm to stop TPU ooze. Use a Washable Glue Stick: Apply a thin, even layer of standard Elmer’s washable glue stick to the parchment paper before printing. It provides just enough tackiness to anchor fine details (like text and icons). Any leftover residue on the fabric completely dissolves on the shirt's very first wash cycle! Bed Temp: Drop the bed to 45°C and secure the paper tightly with strong magnets around the perimeter to keep it perfectly flat. Ironing: Place the print design-side-down on the shirt, press firmly with a dry iron (Medium/Wool setting) for 15 seconds without sliding it around, and let it cool completely before peeling! Enjoy printing this, and make sure to post your makes below—I'd love to see what designs you create! Happy printing!

description: I bring to you a glasses/sunglasses case that features a magnetic latch mechanism, allowing one-hand operation. It uses 3 12x3mm magnets to enable a tight locking/unlocking mechanism depending on the position of the latch. Make sure to insert the magnets using the right polarity, such that one of them will attract the magnet in the latch—securing the case in the closed position—, while the other will repel it—pushing it away and, hence, opening the case. In the print profile you will find two plates with one version each: “Independent_parts”. This plate prints the bottom and top parts independently, so you can print them in different colors. You will have to put them together to enable the hinge mechanism. Be aware that it might require some strength to insert the hinge in place. “Print_in_place”. This second plate features a print-in-place version. You won't have to put the top and bottom parts together, since they will be already printed together, with the hinge in place after printing. It might require a slight "breaking" by turning the hinge, just in case that the clearance is to tight for your printer resolution, but the parts should be apart enough to avoid melting and still providing the hinge natural rotating motion. There is a lot of room for improvement/enhancing, and I will continue working on this model to provide more sizes, as well as softer inserts to keep the glasses even more secure inside the case. Happy printing/protecting/transporting!

description: Description Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. The result is a durable and eye-catching 3D design that combines modern 3D printing technology with fashion. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. The result is a durable and eye-catching 3D design that combines modern 3D printing technology with fashion. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. Do not tumble dry at high temperatures. ⚠️ Washing or drying at excessive temperatures may cause the 3D print to loosen or peel from the fabric over time.

This is a fully 3D-printable eyewear design that you can print, finish, and assemble entirely at home. It requires no screws, hinges, or extra hardware—all you need is some super glue and a bit of post-processing to get a clean, functional pair of glasses. This model is designed to support standard and prescription lenses, making it both a stylish accessory and a practical daily wear option. Key Features Two Sizes Included: Comes in two different sizes to help ensure a proper fit for different face shapes. Lens-Ready: Designed to accommodate both standard non-prescription lenses and prescription lenses. 100% Hardware-Free: No need to source tiny screws or specialized hinges. Easy Assembly: Simple joint design secured with a small amount of super glue. Recommended Print Settings To ensure the best surface finish and structural strength, the following settings are recommended: Layer Height: 0.10mm to 0.15mm (highly recommended for smoother curves and easier sanding) Infill: 40% – 50% Supports: Required. You will need to enable supports for the curved sections of the temples (the arms that go behind the ears). Material Compatibility This model has been tested with several filaments, and you can print it using almost any standard material: Bambu PLA-CF: Highly recommended. The carbon fiber texture provides a premium matte finish and excellent structural rigidity. Wood PLA: Gives a unique, organic aesthetic. It looks great but will require extra sanding and finishing to get a smooth feel. Standard PLA/PETG: Works well and offers a wide range of color choices. Assembly & Post-Processing Sanding: To achieve a comfortable fit and clean look, thoroughly sand the frames and temples. Start with a coarser grit (like 220) to smooth out print lines, and finish with a wet sand (400 to 1000 grit) for a smooth surface. Dry Fit: Test-fit the temples into the frame joints before applying any glue to ensure they align properly. Gluing: Apply a very small drop of super glue (cyanoacrylate) to the connection points. Hold the pieces firmly in place Lens Installation How to install: Standard scanned or custom-cut lenses can be snapped directly into the frame from the inside. Important Note: Do not apply heat (such as hot water or a hairdryer) to the frame during installation. Heating the plastic can cause the printed frame to warp or lose its shape. The lenses are designed to snap into place easily at room temperature.

Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Lifeweave – Pendant, Earrings & Keychain A nature-inspired woven design that can be worn as a pendant, transformed into earrings, or carried as a keychain. Lifeweave is a sculptural accessory inspired by the flowing patterns of nature and the interconnected rhythms of life. The design combines a leaf-like silhouette with an intertwined double-helix form, creating a piece that feels both organic and symbolic. Its continuous curves evoke growing vines, woven roots, and the invisible threads that connect all living things. The open structure keeps the design lightweight while allowing light and shadow to pass through the form, emphasizing its elegant geometry from every angle. Although originally designed as a pendant, the versatile shape also works beautifully as a pair of earrings, a keychain charm, or other wearable accessories. Simply scale the model to suit different applications and personal styles. Designed specifically for 3D printing, Lifeweave transforms into a small piece of wearable sculpture that can be carried, worn, and customized in many different ways. More than just an accessory, it is a symbolic object that celebrates nature, growth, and connection. Features • Organic leaf-inspired silhouette with a flowing woven structure. • Symbolizes growth, connection, and the continuity of life. • Multi-purpose design: pendant, earrings, keychain, or decorative charm. • Lightweight open-frame structure with an elegant sculptural appearance. • Optimized for both FDM and resin 3D printing. • Easily scalable to create different sizes and accessories. • Looks stunning in matte, metallic, silk, or colorful filament finishes. • Designed to feel like a real piece of jewelry with a satisfying sense of weight. Printing Notes The original model height is 60 mm , but it can be freely scaled up or down to suit different applications, including pendants, earrings, keychains, and decorative charms. For the best wearing experience, the model is intended to be printed with 100% infill (solid print) . The additional weight gives the piece a more substantial, premium feel, making it resemble a real piece of jewelry rather than a lightweight plastic accessory. To preserve the most elegant orientation and showcase the flowing geometry of the design, the model is intended to be printed starting from its smallest contact point on the build plate . Because the print begins from a very small footprint, it is recommended to: Reduce the printing speed for the first layers. Use a small amount of support material to improve stability during printing. Ensure good bed adhesion before continuing the print. This printing orientation minimizes visible support marks on the most important surfaces and allows the final piece to display its best aesthetic qualities. Depending on your printer, material, and scaling, minor adjustments to support settings may be required. The model is intentionally oriented to prioritize beauty over convenience, resulting in cleaner surfaces, a more sculptural final appearance, and a satisfying weight in the hand. description: Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. The result is a durable and eye-catching 3D design that combines modern 3D printing technology with fashion. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. Do not tumble dry at high temperatures. ⚠️ Washing or drying at excessive temperatures may cause the 3D print to loosen or peel from the fabric over time.
